verdict.rationale: Custom dashboards are a fair axis for an LLM observability platform like Phoenix, but the evidence pack never documents a dashboard builder. The docs do show adjacent capabilities: per-trace latency inspection, token-usage breakdowns, eval scoring, and span querying via the SDK. Those are adjacent features and developer building blocks, not configurable dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics, so they earn no credit here.
